slides.teacher_cue: Final lesson of the LUMINOS programme. First: y as /iː/ in -ly, -ty, -ry, -ny, -dy endings — quickly, daily, friendly, lonely, twenty, fifty, every, early, ready. The -ly suffix attached to adjectives makes adverbs: quick → quickly, slow → slowly, friend → friendly. Second: full programme review — from s·a·t to morphological families. You now have the tools to decode the great majority of English words. What remains is vocabulary breadth and reading experience.
slides.expected_response: Students consolidate y=/iː/ in -ly and related endings, and reflect on the full scope of the programme.
slides.correction_move: Review the three y rules one final time. Then run a rapid programme review — students decode challenge words from across all 71 lessons. Celebrate the achievement.
slides.observation_note: Watch for any remaining y=/aɪ/ substitution in multi-syllable words.
